label: Measure AI
description: Baseline and overlay contributions on opposite sides of a neutral line.

label: Govern capital
description: Capital passes policy, risk, and access gates.

label: Plug in
description: Existing data, strategy, and execution components connect to one adapter.

label: Strategy and asset switching
description: Incumbent and candidate paths meet a comparison gate.

label: AI/PSM review
description: Reviewed conviction moves size within lower and upper bounds.

label: Replay and attribution
description: A replay timeline connects decisions to positive and negative contributions.

label: Set the capital budget
description: Capital is split between deployed allocation and retained cash.

label: Allocate across sleeves
description: A portfolio budget branches into three sleeve allocations.

label: Size each position
description: A base position passes through a size multiplier to a proposed weight.

label: Apply portfolio limits
description: Position exposure bars remain beneath a configured limit.

label: Measure the outcome
description: Recorded weights connect to capital-weighted outcome rows.

label: Regime replay
description: Distinct trend, shock, and range segments appear along a replay path.

label: Sleeve state
description: Selected assets, strategy, and position weights share a sleeve record.

label: Decision record
description: Timestamped event rows record changing positions.

label: Asset Managers
description: A manager mandate routes through allocation to client reports.

label: Banks
description: Internal systems sit behind a security boundary with an audit record.

label: Quantamental Teams
description: Quantitative signals and reviewed evidence meet at a forward test.

label: Reduce noise
description: A noisy raw signal is compared with a smoother filtered path.

label: Improve governance
description: Context, mandate, risk, and history converge on one review.

label: Explain performance
description: Four attribution stages show both contribution and drag.

label: Not just execution
description: Reviewed signal becomes capital intent before execution.

label: Not fixed exposure
description: Allocation composition changes between two market regimes.

label: Not black-box AI
description: Visible prompt, response, and risk packets are retained together.

label: Before
description: A signal is examined before it passes a capital gate.

label: During
description: Reviewed evidence leads to an action, size, and risk-aware intent.

label: After
description: An outcome report is filed into a reusable organizational archive.

label: Recover
description: A paused run resumes from a preserved checkpoint.

label: Inspect
description: Model input and output documents are examined with a magnifier.

label: Attribute
description: A waterfall separates base strategy from switching and sizing effects.

label: Pair-aware
description: Two correlated asset paths are examined as one relationship.

label: Neutrality
description: Long and short exposures balance around a central neutrality target.

label: Outcome
description: Long and short contributions are compared with the resulting basket.

label: Basket quality
description: A suitability matrix checks correlation, volatility, liquidity, and spread.

label: Strategy fit
description: A regime selector routes to trend or mean-reversion behavior.

label: Capital balance
description: Relative long and short sizes remain within a sleeve budget.

label: Visible
description: Named review stations leave traceable handoffs in the decision chain.

label: Controlled
description: Mandatory rules constrain routing and outputs at a control gate.

label: Auditable
description: Linked prompt, response, reuse, and outcome records form an audit trail.
